text: {"table": {"name": "qualifying", "purpose": "Formula 1 qualifying session results: one row per driver per race, with their lap times in each qualifying segment (Q1, Q2, Q3) and final grid position."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "qualifyId", "description": "Primary key of the qualifying table; unique surrogate identifier for each driver's qualifying entry.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "raceId", "description": "Reference to races.col_001; identifies the race (grand prix weekend) this qualifying result belongs to.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "driverId", "description": "Reference to drivers.col_001; identifies the driver who set these qualifying times.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "constructorId", "description": "Reference to constructors.col_001; identifies the team the driver qualified for in this race.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "code", "name": "number", "description": "Driver's car number for the race (0-99 range, matches F1 car numbers).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "code", "name": "position", "description": "Final qualifying (grid) position, 1-28, with each position appearing roughly once per race.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "free_text", "name": "q1", "description": "Driver's best lap time in qualifying segment Q1, formatted m:ss.mmm; null if no time set.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "free_text", "name": "q2", "description": "Driver's best lap time in qualifying segment Q2, formatted m:ss.mmm; null if eliminated in Q1 or no time set (hence ~51% null).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "free_text", "name": "q3", "description": "Driver's best lap time in qualifying segment Q3, formatted m:ss.mmm; null if eliminated before Q3 or no time set (hence ~71% null).", "status": "resolved"}}}
